title: There's a Hole in Your Vision Right Now

lines.text: There's a hole in your vision. Right now.
lines.delivery: Quiet certainty, almost conspiratorial. Small beat between 'vision' and 'Right now'.

lines.text: Want to find it? Close your left eye. Stare at the cross.
lines.delivery: Friendly and practical, like guiding someone through a magic trick. Give them a moment after each instruction.

lines.text: Now slowly bring your phone closer...
lines.delivery: Slow down with the instruction itself. Suspend the pitch: the sentence continues.
Soft, a little amused. Then LEAVE SPACE: this pause is for the viewer to try it.

lines.text: That's your blind spot: where your optic nerve leaves the eye, nothing detects light.
lines.delivery: Reveal tone, a touch of 'gotcha'. Clean and clear on 'nothing detects light'.

lines.text: You never notice, because your brain paints over it.
lines.delivery: Warm admiration for the brain. Lean on 'paints'.

lines.text: And that's not the only edit.
You blink about fifteen times a minute, and never see the darkness.
lines.delivery: Light and conversational; let 'never see the darkness' sound slightly eerie.

lines.text: Your eyes jump about three times a second. Even now, reading this.
lines.delivery: Matter-of-fact, then personal on 'Even now, reading this' — as if catching them in the act.

lines.text: Each jump smears the image, so your brain cuts the blur...
lines.delivery: Crisp consonants on 'cuts'. Suspend the pitch at the end: the thought continues.

lines.text: then covers the gap by stretching the next image back in time.
lines.delivery: Slow down on 'back in time' and let it land: this is the strange part.

lines.text: That's why, when you glance at a clock, the second hand seems to freeze.
lines.delivery: Recognition: most people have seen this. Slight smile, then hold 'freeze'.

lines.text: It didn't. Your brain stretched it.
lines.delivery: Two short beats. Firm on 'didn't', then intimate on 'Your brain stretched it'.

lines.text: You're not seeing the world live. You're seeing an edit.
lines.delivery: The thesis. Calm, deliberate, slightly slower. Contrast 'live' and 'edit'.

lines.text: One so good, you never noticed the hole...
lines.delivery: Trail off with the pitch suspended: the video loops straight into 'There's a hole in your vision. Right now.'
